directControl: C uses a volatile function pointer so repeated empty-message calls cannot be hoisted or folded; every iteration must perform a call, matching opaque CommonCrypto and RF2 calls.
scope: Same complete SHA API work, input mutation, digest-byte sum and verified result. Timed loops inside each process after a warmup hash. Excludes startup, file loading, allocation, first feature query and first constant initialization. Not compression-only or cycles; runtime/API overhead remains. One uncontrolled host; no universal speed, energy or AI-token claim.
